description: TN-23 is the Regional Transport Office for Vellore, one of the oldest and most prominent administrative hubs in Tamil Nadu. It handles a high volume of registrations for personal and commercial vehicles, particularly given the city's status as a healthcare and educational center. The RTO oversees driving licenses, vehicle fitness certifications, and road tax collection for the Vellore taluk and surrounding regions.
address: No. 482, Phase II, TNHB, Sathuvachari, Vellore
